posts.title: Week 46, 2026: Hard-boiled
posts.description: My life here, on this sofa bed, is starkly different to the one I’d been living for the last six months. Let me tell you about my life on this sofa bed. I wake up late and it doesn’t feel too bad. My sleep mask has become my most functional accessory. It shields my eyes from the scenery I conjure up easily using my other senses. posts.description: On the second day of November, and the first day of the week, I was filled with hope and vigour that I haven’t felt since October 16th. posts.title: Week 44, 2026: Real city girl
posts.description: Sorry for getting this out to you later than I’d like. I never factor in the possibility of illness, nor the subsequent dread when something unwritten becomes overdue. Sorry, too, for being so far away. I miss having the space to think hard and long when editorializing my week. The new bob has been helping at least.
